title: feat(metadata-protocol): ensure door for a read-only base's paired customization package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxSrmC56pjkzCzxHmbpYUu4i)_

Fixes #28407

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
The new route `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/ensure-customization` and its two schemas (`EnsureCustomizationPackageRequestSchema`, `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponseSchema`) widen the surface, and `POST /api/v1/packages` and the duplicate door's target narrow theirs: a pair-shaped id (`BASE.custom`) is refused unless its manifest declares the pair namespace and a dependency on the base.

Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the `/packages` doors or `client.packages`; the docs half is in this diff (the generated API reference for the two schemas, and the packages row of `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/ensure-customization` 与 SDK `client.packages.ensureCustomization`,为已安装的只读基础包答出它的配对定制包 `BASE.custom`,缺则经安装原语创建(命名空间 `BASE_NS_custom`,依赖基础包 `^MAJOR`);安装门、安装原语和复制门拒收缺这两项的配对形 id。
- 为什么改:ADR-0146 D3 的配对定制包此前没有创建入口,手工安装会从 id 派生出 `custom` 命名空间,也不声明对基础包的依赖。
- 风险与回滚:新路由是纯新增;收窄只拦 id 形如 `BASE.custom` 且缺显式命名空间或缺依赖的安装与复制,导出的完整配对照常安装。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts`(`ensurePairOnce` 与同一配对的单飞等待)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(新门的鉴权顺序与 `POST /packages` 的配对拒收)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`(安装原语里的同一谓词)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 35 passed (35)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`** (`api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`): `EnsureCustomizationPackageRequestSchema` (strict, one key `basePackageId`) and `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponseSchema` (six required fields: `basePackageId`, `packageId`, `namespace`, `dependencyRange`, `created`, `writable`), with their `z.input` / `z.infer` aliases. No existing shape moves. The authorable surface gains exactly these 7 keys (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`): `EnsureCustomizationPackageRequest:basePackageId`, and `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponse:` `basePackageId`, `created`, `dependencyRange`, `namespace`, `packageId`, `writable`; the JSON-schema manifest gains the two schema names. That move is why the kind is `added` and spec is `minor` (see Acceptance notes).
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: a new module `protocol-customization-package.ts` holds the body of the new class method `ensureCustomizationPackage` (the protocol.ts split pattern) and the predicate `customizationPairManifestRefusal`, exported from the package index.
  - Create: the pair id, namespace and range come from the N-08 helpers in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`, never a local copy. The pair is installed through `this.installPackage` with manifest id `BASE.custom`, name `BASE_NAME (custom)`, version `0.1.0`, type `module`, explicit `namespace`, and `dependencies` naming the base at `^MAJOR`.
  - Idempotent: an existing pair that declares the namespace and a dependency on the base is answered unchanged (`created: false`, its own declared range). One that lacks either is refused `409` and never adopted or rewritten.
  - Concurrency: calls for the same pair on the same registry are single-flighted. A call that arrives while another is creating the pair waits for it to settle and then judges the registry afresh, so it never answers for a pair whose persist then fails and is undone.
  - Refusals, each leaving no package: `400` malformed request or base that is itself a pair; `404` base not installed; `409` writable base, base with no namespace, base namespace too long for the `_custom` suffix (nothing truncated or hashed), non-SemVer base version, or an installed pair lacking namespace or dependency; `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` when another package owns the pair namespace (the registry's code), including an owner the registry would read as a co-owner.
  - The predicate: an install whose id is pair-shaped must declare the explicit pair namespace (the exact one when the base is installed) and a dependency on the base, or it is refused `400` naming the ensure door. `installPackage` asks it (every in-process caller, and the duplicate's copy record), and `duplicatePackage` asks it before reading a row.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**: the route in `domains/packages.ts`, gated as the install door is: `manage_metadata`, then the walled refusal (only the platform operator under `isolated` / `group`), then the closed query set (empty), then a body check (no body or `{}`; a body with keys is `400`, never ignored). `201` when created, `200` when present; `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` keeps its facts. `POST /packages` asks the predicate before either install limb. The route is mounted in `dispatcher-plugin.ts` and has a ledger row in `route-ledger.ts` (`disposition: 'sdk'`, client `packages.ensureCustomization`, response schema named); the census sentence reads 114.
- **`@objectstack/client`**: `packages.ensureCustomization(baseId)` returns `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponse`; `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` counts 18 packages methods.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts` (new, 35 tests) over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, with a recording `sys_packages` publish double. It covers: create `com.acme.crm.custom` with namespace `crm_custom` (not `custom`) and `^3`, `201`, parsed through the response schema, persisted once, read back by `GET`; a code-provided base; re-ensure `200 created:false` with no write; an exported valid pair answered unchanged; every refusal with its ADR-0112 envelope and no package or write left; walled `isolated` and `group`, where the tenant admin gets `403` and the operator `201`; `single` gives `201`; the capability gate; two real concurrent calls give one `201`, one `200`, one write and one pair; the persist-failure race; `POST /packages` on both arms (three refused shapes, an exported pair that declares both installs, a non-pair id untouched); an exported pair whose base is absent gets `422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING`; the install primitive refuses an in-process pair manifest; the duplicate into a pair id is `400` before any row is read.
- Door-family sweeps gain the new door: walled refusal (fourteen doors), capability gate, closed query, and the `501` probe in handle-typing.
- Spec conformance in `api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`: the strict request refuses `namespace` and `dependencyRange`, and the response capture parses and requires every member. Client: URL, method, no body, URL-encoding and the answer; return-type precision pins `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponse`.
- The card's two named tests stay green: `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.test.ts` (10/10) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace.test.ts` (13/13).

## Acceptance notes

- **Declaration measured.** `check-changeset-no-major`, driven with a `pull_request` payload declaring `Metadata-protocol: none`, exits 1 because the two new schemas move `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (the 7 keys above). With `added` and `@objectstack/spec` at `minor` (metadata-protocol, runtime and client `patch`) it exits 0, and `check-adr-0087-registration` exits 0, verifying `not-required (runtime-interface-only packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#ObjectStackProtocolImplementation)`.
- **OpenAPI: nothing to regenerate.** `packages/spec/json-schema/openapi.json` is gitignored and its generator (`build-openapi.ts`) emits only nine fixed contract schemas and no `paths`. The served route section is built at serve time by `packages/rest` from its route manager, so no committed artifact names a route.
- **N-08 consequence.** `customizationBasePackageId` reads any id ending in `.custom` as a pair, so a package named `com.acme.custom` is now the pair of `com.acme` at the install doors and needs both declarations. This follows from the ruled id rule, and is not new policy here.
- **Prerelease base, read and not tested.** A base at a prerelease version gets `^MAJOR`, and ADR-0141 D2's check does not admit a prerelease, so the pair's own install would be `422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING` at the ensure door (the route keeps the facts).
- **Existing pair range.** The ensure door checks that an existing pair declares a dependency on the base, not that its range admits the installed base; ADR-0141 D2 judged that at the pair's install.
- **Concurrency scope.** The single-flight is per process and per registry. Two nodes ensuring the same pair at once fall to the `sys_packages` key; that was not measured. The plain two-call test is green with or without the single-flight (B6 reddens only the persist-failure race), which is why both tests exist.
- **Ablation evidence for the B legs.** `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` read exit 1 on the marker for every B leg, because esbuild folds the planted `void "MARKER"` to `void 0`. The mutations did reach dist: every B leg went red with the runtime source untouched, and the emitted guard read `if (!base && (void 0, false))` for B13.
- **Outside the literal file surface.** `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` (the mount), `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (row and census), `packages/client/src/index.ts` and two client tests (the SDK the card asks for), four door-family sweep tests, and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`.
- **Serial with #28414.** `origin/main` had not moved from the base when the gates ran, so there was nothing to rebase.
